earnings.title: Media Relations
highlights: (Con Edison) (NYSE: ED) today reported 2026 third quarter net income of $766 million or $2.07 a share compared with $688 million or $1.91 a share in the 2025 third quarter.
For the first nine months of 2026, net income was $1,998 million or $5.44 a share compared with $1,726 million or $4.84 a share in the first nine months of 2025.
Reported earnings per share (basic) and net income (GAAP basis) $2.07 $1.91 $766 $688 $5.44 $4.84 $1,998 $1,726
Adjusted earnings per share and adjusted earnings (non-GAAP basis) $2.07 $1.90 $766 $686 $5.08 $4.82 $1,864 $1,718

quotes.text: Con Edison is a durable, long-term investment, supported by consistent performance, financial strength, and our ability to navigate an evolving landscape.
quotes.by: Tim Cawley, Chairman and CEO of Con Edison

quotes.text: We see a bright future as we expand our earnings base with strategic upgrades to our energy delivery systems that help us maintain our industry-leading reliability and provide attractive, steady earnings opportunities.
quotes.by: Kirk Andrews, Senior Vice President and CFO

outlook: For the year of 2026, Con Edison expects its adjusted earnings per share (non-GAAP) to be in the range of $6.05 to $6.15 per share.
Con Edison ’ s previous forecast was in the range of $6.00 to $6.20 per share .
